title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode20 The First Song

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you've come.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm writing a song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
You were writing a song last time you were here as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You must enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Enjoy...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't really understand what enjoying something feels like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's stopped speaking again.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She'll probably be working on her songs all day again.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That's all she's been doing ever since she first came here.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And yet...she has yet to find her true feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder if there is anything I can do to help her find them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I just can't seem to think of any good ideas...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What should I do?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I get the feeling just sitting here worrying about it isn't going to help me come up with something.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If I take a look around this SEKAI, maybe I'll think of something.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It looks like I'm back where I started.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Now what? I wasn't able to think of anything...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There's so many more pages than before.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It looks like she's been writing this entire time.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What can I possibly do to help her?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku, that song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How do you know that song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've known this song...from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: From the beginning?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes. Since this SEKAI was created.
That's why I sing it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. So you've always known it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's gone back to writing her songs...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Still, I am a little relieved that she still pays some attention to things other than the songs she is writing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder if this song is important to her somehow.)
